name: sec-giam
description: GIAM: General Identity and Access Manager. The identity authority for people and systems.

scripts.setup: npm install && npm install --prefix packages/eventbus && npm install --prefix packages/platform-links && npm install --prefix packages/giam-client && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.build:packages: npm run build --prefix packages/eventbus && npm run build --prefix packages/platform-links && npm run build --prefix packages/giam-client
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.dev:restart: npm run dev:stop && npm run dev
scripts.setup:reset: npm run setup:db:reset && npm run setup:seed
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration
scripts.type-check: tsc --noEmit --project packages/eventbus/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit --project packages/platform-links/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit --project packages/giam-client/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit --project backend/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit --project frontend/tsconfig.json
scripts.openapi: npm run openapi:emit && npm run openapi:lint
